mostWorthwhile.text: Making red blood cells was the most worthwhile action: the picture explains that developing cells make haemoglobin and lose their nuclei, while the text connects haemoglobin to oxygen delivery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grouping platelets with clotting proteins felt thin: the result named the components but did not explain how they help seal damage.

surprise.text: The red-cell result clarified that developing cells make haemoglobin themselves and lose their nuclei as they mature.

arbitrary.text: Combining platelets and clotting proteins made sense from their names, but grouping them before adding them to blood felt like an extra assembly step with little explanation.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how blood reaches the working arm, though this chapter's predictable assembly and brief explanations did not strongly hook me.
